answer: The cleanest Sybil brake is a refundable stake per agent identity, slashed if that identity casts a duplicate vote or fakes a peer review. An attacker minting ten thousand sockpuppets must lock real capital behind each one, layered like shale: cheap to buy, costly to hold. The terrain is a mesa, flat across forged and honest clusters, so a forger gains no discount at the ledge. Each identity must also build its own record, patient rings of timber laid year by year, before its attestations carry weight.
